Free TTS Online

Free TTS online means one thing: paste text, press play and hear it immediately. The converter runs in the browser tab, so there is no sign-up step, no email gate and no installer between you and the audio.

The first screen is the tool itself. A large text box accepts up to five thousand characters, a voice picker sits underneath, and the play button starts playback as soon as the text is parsed.

Text to speech quality depends on the voice set. The default voices are optimized for speed, while the neural set handles punctuation, numbers and acronyms with noticeably fewer retakes.

Playback controls stay visible during export. You can pause, scrub and replay a sentence before downloading the finished track, which saves a full regeneration cycle when a single line sounds wrong.

Privacy is part of the design. Audio is synthesized locally, the source text never leaves the device, and no account history is stored on a server.

Teams that need longer passages can unlock the paid tier. It removes the character cap, adds batch export and keeps the same interface, so nothing has to be relearned.

If you are comparing tools, look for three things: instant playback without an account, a visible character counter, and a download button that does not hide behind a paywall. This page is built around those three requirements.

Start with a short paragraph, confirm the voice, then paste the full script. The converter keeps the last voice selection, so repeat visits skip the setup step.

Mobile users get the same controls in a single column. The text box grows with the keyboard, the play button stays pinned above the fold, and the download action appears only after the first successful playback.

Nothing on this page asks for a credit card. The free tier is the product, and the paid tier exists for people who already know the workflow and simply need longer passages.
